patterns.name: Breakpoint-specific Pocket campaign field
patterns.scope: homepage Pokémon TCG Pocket asset field
patterns.intent: Give the product composite a campaign-specific pale-blue field whose authored crop remains effective at each observed width.
observableRules: desktop uses background.jpg
mobile uses header_bg-small.jpg
mobile is an asset swap rather than an arbitrary desktop crop
the field stays full bleed within its section region
suitableFor: the Pocket section asset field at the evidenced desktop and mobile breakpoints

patterns.name: Equal-split product and copy handoff
patterns.scope: homepage Pokémon TCG Pocket section at desktop
patterns.intent: Balance campaign recognition and product explanation with equal spatial authority.
observableRules: 1440px section splits into two 720px columns
asset field is left and opaque-black copy field is right
copy order is H2, paragraph, CTA
the section has hard full-width boundaries rather than a floating shell
suitableFor: the desktop Pocket cross-site product promotion

patterns.name: Asset-first mobile product handoff
patterns.scope: homepage Pokémon TCG Pocket section at 390px mobile
patterns.intent: Lead with immediate campaign recognition, then give copy a dedicated full-width reading field.
observableRules: asset field precedes the copy field
copy field is full-width opaque black
the transparent composite has 10px side insets
the layout is a vertical recomposition rather than a shrunken desktop row
suitableFor: the mobile Pocket section at the evidenced narrow width

patterns.name: Single composite product signature
patterns.scope: homepage Pokémon TCG Pocket campaign composition
patterns.intent: Express product identity through one authored transparent logo-and-cards composition without requiring a flattened section screenshot.
observableRules: logo-cards.png is one independent transparent raster
it renders approximately 700x428.4 on desktop and 370x226.44 on mobile
its internal logo/card relationship stays intrinsic to the asset
no additional carousel, card tilt, or independent card-layer behavior was observed
suitableFor: Pocket campaign identity inside this section

patterns.name: Black product-copy anchor
patterns.scope: homepage Pokémon TCG Pocket copy field
patterns.intent: Create a decisive, high-contrast explanation and exit point beside or after the pale campaign composition.
observableRules: panel is opaque black and rectangular
desktop occupies the right half
mobile spans full width after the asset field
content is exactly one centered H2, one centered paragraph, and one centered CTA
suitableFor: the Pocket section's copy and action group

patterns.name: Italic product-callout type hierarchy
patterns.scope: homepage Pokémon TCG Pocket copy field
patterns.intent: Use a compact italic display title for energy while retaining a readable neutral body and direct action label.
observableRules: desktop H2 is Kanit italic 700 at 40/44
mobile H2 is Kanit italic 700 at 28/30.8 and wraps to two lines
body is centered PT Sans at 18/28.8 on both widths
CTA is PT Sans italic 700 at 20/24 desktop and 18/22.5 mobile
there is no kicker
suitableFor: Pocket section H2, paragraph, and CTA label
forbiddenRoles: forced line breaks copied from screenshots

patterns.name: White external action with localized gold hover
patterns.scope: homepage Pokémon TCG Pocket Play Now CTA
patterns.intent: Provide a singular high-contrast exit from the black panel and reserve gold for a restrained hover response.
observableRules: resting background is white with black label and arrow
hover changes label and arrow to rgb(226,186,101)
hover keeps the white background unchanged
href is https://tcgpocket.pokemon.com/en-us
the action is external to the source homepage

patterns.name: Entry hidden and settled endpoints
patterns.scope: homepage Pokémon TCG Pocket viewport entry
patterns.intent: Record only the two observed render endpoints without pretending the transition choreography was learned.
observableRules: hidden asset endpoint is opacity 0 with translateY(-214.199px)
hidden heading and body endpoints are opacity 0 with translateX(328px)
hidden CTA endpoint is opacity 0 with translateX(94.98px)
settled endpoint is opacity 1 with identity transforms
no reliable intermediate visual frame was captured
suitableFor: diagnostic documentation of Pocket entry endpoints

mustNotInvent: extra kicker, CTA, carousel, or card interaction
notes: The browser-extension overlay is explicitly excluded as polluted evidence.
Black, equal split, and mobile background swapping remain section-local.
Gold is approved only for this CTA's foreground hover.
Motion endpoints are recorded, but no motion recipe is approved.
